mcqs.question: What current name does the review give alongside pulmonary veno-occlusive disease?

options.A: PAH with overt features of venous/capillary involvement
options.B: Chronic thromboembolic disease as a synonym
options.E: The review uses no alternate name

mcqs.correctAnswerText: PAH with overt features of venous/capillary involvement
mcqs.explanation: PVOD is also known as PAH with overt features of venous/capillary involvement.

sourceRefs.excerpt: pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) with overt features of venous/capillary involvement

mcqs.question: Why does the review say early lung-transplant referral is essential?

options.A: The response to therapy is poor compared with other PAH
options.B: PVOD is cured by oral anticoagulation
options.D: The response is better than other PAH
options.E: Referral is optional after many years of stability in every patient

mcqs.correctAnswerText: The response to therapy is poor compared with other PAH
mcqs.explanation: Early referral is essential because of the poor response to therapy compared with other forms of PAH.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Early referral to a lung transplant centre is essential due to the poor response to therapy when compared with other forms of PAH.

mcqs.question: What histologic lesion does the review say lung explants show?

options.D: Only capillary haemangiomas of the skin

mcqs.explanation: Explants show microvascular remodelling with typical fibrous veno-occlusive lesions.

mcqs.question: When does the review say immunosuppressive drugs may be used in PVOD?

options.A: Generally not, except in systemic diseases such as SLE
options.B: In every patient as first-line treatment
options.D: They are mandatory before any other drug
options.E: The review does not mention immunosuppression

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Generally not, except in systemic diseases such as SLE
mcqs.explanation: Immunosuppressive drugs are generally not recommended except in systemic diseases such as SLE.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Immunosuppressive drugs are generally not recommended for PAH and PVOD, except in cases of systemic diseases such as systemic lupus erythematosus.

mcqs.question: What haemodynamic consequence does the review link to the venous and capillary involvement?

options.E: The review does not mention resistance

mcqs.explanation: Venous and capillary involvement leads to increased pulmonary vascular resistance. The question uses that phrase from the review.
